info.title: OpenSkiTime Live API
info.summary: Read published alpine ski races: start lists, race progress and unofficial results.
info.description: The HTTP part of the OpenSkiTime Live API. Changes in real time come from the SignalR hub /live, which OpenAPI cannot describe; see https://openskiti.me/live-api/. Its messages are the schemas SyncMessage, DeltaMessage and BeaconMessage.

servers.description: Local live timing on the race computer (default address)

get.description: Every race with published state, newest race date first. An empty list means that no race is published.

404.description: The server has no state for this ID: unknown, not published yet, not restored after a server restart, expired or deleted.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests from this address. Wait before trying again.
